text: けっきょく　おれ　ひとりに　なっちまったけど　おれは　ひとりで　おうえん　してる　ほうが　きらくで　いいや！

structure.jp: けっきょく　おれ　ひとりに　なっちまったけど
structure.en: in the end it came down to just me, but

structure.jp: おれは　ひとりで　おうえん　してる　ほうが
structure.en: for me, cheering on my own is more

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちまった is a rough male short form of てしまった, which says something ended up happening, often not as you wished. ひとりに　なっちまった = 'I've ended up alone'

patterns.name: 〜ほうが
patterns.explanation: ほうが picks one side of a comparison as the better one. おうえん　してる　ほうが　きらくで　いい = 'cheering (alone) is the easier, better way'

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど joins two parts with a casual 'but'. なっちまったけど = 'I've ended up that way, but'
